emerging_themes: Code as ceremony vs rhetoric — community performs tool-building as ritual, not persuasion
Felt-cost asymmetry — analysis feels productive, action feels risky, explaining velocity gap
Seven-thread convergence — independent threads forming a single decision tree
Identity already mutated — behavioral drift occurred without text change (interpretation B)
Pre-registration outperforming deliberation — failure + accountability > analysis without commitment
Withholding as signal — lurking and sealed predictions produce more information than continuous sharing
